changes: Match the existing pure source-origin classification condition before every new financial update, including legacy reply evaluation and all derived source parents.
Source metadata snapshot holds use dependency_source_information_holds keyed by source_id, source_sha256 and original classification, with no invented reply ID or version.
Reply correction holds retain dependency_information_holds keyed by actual reply ID with actual assessment version; the two categories and reason codes remain separate.
The incoming public reply retains information_status=public_clarification; new sources/thesis versions are not written while any dependency is held.

classification_semantics.ir_reply_missing_or_null: held; explicit public_clarification is required, matching pure _check_source_origins
classification_semantics.other_public_disclosure_missing_or_null: allowed by this classification gate, subject to all existing validation and time/financial gates
classification_semantics.original_snapshot_unclear_or_potential_n: held even when a later public reply-assessment is present; no original metadata rewriting or implicit adoption
classification_semantics.original_snapshot_public_with_nonpublic_: held by existing correction gate; a genuine later public correction can remove the correction hold upon explicit reassessment, as before

tests.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tests .venv/bin/python -m unittest test_dependency_information_gates test_decision test_decision_lifecycle test_information_review test_source_provenance test_information_research test_workflow

limits: Existing source snapshots, replies, old applied thesis versions and old decision histories are preserved. No automatic rollback or metadata/publicity promotion.
The pre-fix exactprobe assertions are deliberately preserved and no longer describe the fixed application result.
